description:
SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
Superior-Union
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 26002231
DOCKET NO. L0084326 JUDGMENT # J05452426
PLAINTIFF – ANDREW ALTOBELLI
DEFENDANTS- ANDREW ALTOBELLI vs BBI HOLDINGS LLC; BBI HOLDINGS LLC d/b/a BBI CAPITAL LLC; BBI HOLDINGS LLC d/b/a BBI CAPITAL HOLDINGS LLC; d/b/a BBI CAPITAL FL I LLC; COREY SINGMAN, INDIVIDUALLY; AND JARED KABAN T/A BBI HOLDINGS LLC
Writ of Execution.
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public venue on
Wednesday THE 4th DAY OF November 2026
between the hours of two and five o'clock in the afternoon of said day, that is to say at 2:00 P.M. prevailing time at Warinanco Ice Skating Center, 1 Park Drive, Roselle, New Jersey 07203 to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the town of WESTFIELD, County of Union and State of New Jersey:
Being known as: LOT 16 BLOCK 1004
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
311 PROSPECT STREET WESTFIELD, NJ 07090
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Union County Sheriff.
Lien(s)/Taxes: Dimensions of Lot (Approximately): BEGINNING at a point in the southwesterly sideline of Prospect Street, distant 98.62 feet. Northwesterly from the intersection of the same with the northwesterly sideline of Cowperthwaith Place and running; thence
1 . South 44 degrees 46 minutes West 182.12 feet to a point; thence
2. North 47 degrees 53 minutes West 98.96 feet to a point; thence
3. North 44 degrees 25 minutes East 184.96 feet to a point in the southwesterly sideline of Prospect Street; thence
4. Along the southwesterly sideline of Prospect Street, South 46 degrees 15 minutes East 100 feet to the point and place of BEGINNING.
Nearest Cross Street: W. Dudley Avenue
Plaintiff’s good faith estimate of its upset price as of the scheduled November 4, 2026, sale date is $2,304,172.52, (calculated as follows: Judgment entered May 7, 2026, in the amount of $2,237,823.00, less a post-judgment payment of $5,689.75, plus $72,039.27 in post-judgment interest accrued through November 4, 2026. This amount is subject to adjustment through the date of sale and does not include any additional costs, Sheriff’s fees or commission, or additional sums as may be ordered by the Court).
*THE SHERIFF HEREBY RESERVES THE RIGHT TO ADJOURN THIS SALE WITHOUT
FURTHER NOTICE THROUGH PUBLICATION.*
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Union County Sheriff Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interests remain of record and/or have priority over the judgment lien being executed upon and, if so, the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Judgment Debtor, the Judgment Creditor, or the Judgment Creditor’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the judgment debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to applicable Court Rules stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $2,237,823.00 plus continuing post-judgment interest, costs, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission less any post-judgment payments. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration, are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
Peter D. Corvelli
SHERIFF
Advertised on our website: https://ucnj.org/sheriff/functions/sheriffs-sale-information/
DATED: September 30, 2026
NORDLAW
190 STATE HIGHWAY 18
TURNPIKE METROPLEX SUIT 201
EAST BRUNSWICK, NJ 08816
(732)-214-0303
